name: Crossing Moving Average
summary: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy, generating buy signals when a fast moving average crosses above a slow moving average and sell signals when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. It is a classic trend-following system that aims to capture directional moves by entering trades on confirmed crossover events. The EA typically includes configurable MA periods and lot sizing parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了双均线交叉策略，当快速均线上穿慢速均线时产生买入信号，快速均线下穿慢速均线时产生卖出信号。这是一个经典的趋势跟踪系统，旨在通过在确认的交叉事件上进场来捕捉方向性行情。EA通常包含可配置的均线周期和手数参数。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于双移动平均线交叉的核心概念，利用短期均线和长期均线的交叉来判断趋势方向的变化。入场条件为快速均线从下方穿越慢速均线时做多，快速均线从上方穿越慢速均线时做空，这本质上是捕捉趋势启动的信号。出场条件通常是在反向交叉信号出现时平仓并反向开仓，意味着该策略始终在场，没有空仓等待期。仓位管理方面，该EA通常使用固定手数交易，没有根据账户余额或波动率进行动态仓位调整。资金管理较为简单，缺乏止盈止损的精细化设置，完全依赖反向信号来退出头寸。整体而言，这是一个基础的趋势跟踪策略，逻辑清晰但缺乏风险管理的深度设计。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on the core concept of dual moving average crossover, using the crossing of short-term and long-term moving averages to identify changes in trend direction. Entry conditions are: go long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA from below, and go short when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA from above, which essentially captures the initiation of new trends. Exit conditions typically involve closing the current position and opening a reverse position when an opposite crossover signal appears, meaning the strategy is always in the market with no flat periods. Position sizing usually employs fixed lot sizes without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is relatively simplistic, lacking refined take-profit and stop-loss settings, relying entirely on reverse signals to exit positions. Overall, this is a basic trend-following strategy with clear logic but lacking depth in risk management design.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
趋势行情中能够有效捕捉大波段利润
参数少，过拟合风险相对较低
始终在场，不会错过重大趋势行情
双均线交叉是经过长期验证的经典策略框架
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and verify
Effectively captures large trend moves during trending markets
Few parameters, relatively low risk of overfitting
Always in the market, never misses major trend moves
Dual MA crossover is a time-tested classic strategy framework
cons: 震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号，导致连续亏损
均线是滞后指标，入场和出场都存在明显延迟
缺乏止损机制可能导致单笔亏损过大
固定手数交易未考虑账户风险比例管理
始终在场策略在无明显趋势时会持续磨损资金
没有波动率过滤器，在高波动和低波动市场使用相同参数
cons_en: Frequent false signals in ranging/sideways markets leading to consecutive losses
Moving averages are lagging indicators, causing significant delay in both entries and exits
Lack of stop-loss mechanism may result in excessive single-trade losses
Fixed lot sizing does not consider account risk proportion management
Always-in strategy continuously erodes capital during trendless periods
No volatility filter, using same parameters in both high and low volatility markets
improvements: 添加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡行情中减少交易频率
引入动态止损和移动止损机制，保护已有利润
实现基于ATR的动态仓位管理，根据市场波动调整风险敞口
增加新K线检查机制，避免在同一根K线上重复开仓
考虑加入多时间框架确认，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to reduce trading frequency in ranging markets
Implement dynamic and trailing stop-loss mechanisms to protect profits
Realize ATR-based dynamic position sizing to adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Add new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated entries on the same bar
Consider adding multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal reliability

risk_points: 震荡市中频繁虚假信号导致连续小额亏损累积
缺乏止损保护可能导致单笔交易大幅亏损
均线滞后性导致在趋势反转时回吐大量利润
固定仓位未根据账户规模动态调整风险
risk_points_en: Frequent false signals in ranging markets cause accumulation of consecutive small losses
Lack of stop-loss protection may lead to significant single-trade losses
MA lag causes substantial profit giveback during trend reversals
Fixed position sizing does not dynamically adjust risk based on account size
